description:
This workflow allows to identify consecutive groups of a number of solar eclipses within a given time span.

## Associated Tutorial

This workflows is part of the tutorial [Analysing Solar Eclipse Frequency with a Galaxy Workflow](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/topics/digital-humanities/tutorials/solar-eclipse-frequency/tutorial.html), available in the [GTN](https://training.galaxyproject.org)

## Features

* Includes [Galaxy Workflow Tests](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/faqs/gtn/workflow_run_test.html)
* Includes a [Galaxy Workflow Report](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/faqs/galaxy/workflows_report_view.html)
